meta.name: algorithmic-art
meta.description: Creating algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness and interactive parameter exploration. Use this when users request creating art using code, generative art, algorithmic art, flow fields, or particle systems. Create original algorithmic art rather than copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用代码生成视觉艺术作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想用代码创作独特的视觉艺术
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to create unique visual art with code

howto.what: 当你想用代码生成视觉艺术时，Claude 会先写一份「算法哲学」说明（.md），再按固定模板创建一个自包含的 p5.js 交互 HTML，内含随机数种子、可调参数与操作界面；相同种子可复现相同画面。
howto.when: 当你说到生成艺术、算法艺术、粒子系统等，或要求用代码作画时触发。

say.text: 创作一幅以‘有机湍流’为理念的生成艺术作品
say.note: Claude 会先写算法哲学说明，再生成可交互页面。

say.text: 做一个种子可复现的流场粒子 p5.js 作品
say.note: 同一种子每次生成相同画面。

say.text: 生成一个带参数调节的交互式算法艺术作品
say.note: 侧栏可调参数并重新生成。

howto.what_en: For code-art requests, Claude writes an algorithmic philosophy .md, then creates one self-contained p5.js HTML viewer with seeded randomness, adjustable parameters, and the template's fixed UI; same seed reproduces same output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions generative art, algorithmic art, particle systems, or asks to create art with code.

say_en.text: Create a p5.js generative artwork driven by the idea of 'Organic Turbulence'.
say_en.note: It writes the philosophy .md, then builds the HTML viewer.

say_en.text: Make a seeded, reproducible flow-field particle p5.js piece.
say_en.note: The same seed always draws the same result.

say_en.text: Build an interactive algorithmic artwork with adjustable parameters.
say_en.note: Sidebar controls let you tweak and regenerate.
